MDT Dental Rotary Instruments Manufacturer

MDT Micro Diamond Technologies is a dynamic, high-tech and fast-growing Dental Rotary Instrument manufacturer for Clinical and Lab applications. MDT exports premium FG Diamond & Carbide burs, RA/CA burs, Diamond Strips, HP Pins, Dentals Diamond Discs, Polishers, and Carbide Cutters worldwide.

MDT is ISO, CE, FDA, and MDSAP certified manufacturer. Adhering to strict tolerances and standards, MDT's broad range of sterile and multi-use instruments are manufactured with top quality materials by skilled professionals. MDT's scrupulous Quality Assurance system guarantees an emphasis on consistency.
